features.name: Publicly reachable
features.question: Can the surfaces worth testing be reached without logging in?

features.name: Email / password login
features.question: Do users sign in with an email and a password?

features.name: Social / SSO login
features.question: Can users sign in via Google, GitHub, Microsoft, or a corporate identity provider?

features.name: Bot / WAF protection
features.question: Is the product fronted by Cloudflare, Akamai, DataDome, or a similar bot/WAF service?

features.name: Single-page app
features.question: Is the product a single-page app where navigation often happens without a full page reload?

features.name: Embedded iframes
features.question: Does the product embed third-party content in iframes (payment widgets, OAuth, embedded analytics, video)?

features.name: Simple forms
features.question: Does the product have basic text, email, or phone input fields users fill out?

features.name: Multi-step forms
features.question: Does the product have multi-step wizards, conditional fields, or checkout flows that span multiple pages?

features.name: Payment capture
features.question: Does the product collect card details, typically via a Stripe, Adyen, or Braintree iframe?

features.name: Search-driven UI
features.question: Is typing into a search box the primary way users find records or content?

capabilities.name: Standard Page Loading
capabilities.description: Load a target URL reliably and recognise when the page is ready.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Loads a static page over HTTP and detects DOMContentLoaded.
Waits for network-idle and basic client rendering before acting.
Survives challenge interstitials, redirects, and slow hydration.

capabilities.name: Unauthenticated Exploration
capabilities.description: Explore public surfaces without any credentials.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Visits a single known public URL.
Follows in-domain links to discover public surfaces.
Prioritises high-value public surfaces under a crawl budget.

capabilities.name: Email / Password Login
capabilities.description: Authenticate using an email and password form.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Submits a username/password form on a happy path.
Handles 'forgot password' decoys, remember-me, and post-login redirects.
Recovers from interstitial consent screens and step-up prompts.

capabilities.name: OAuth / SSO Login
capabilities.description: Authenticate via a third-party or federated identity provider.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Completes a single-provider OAuth happy path.
Handles provider chooser screens and consent dialogs.
Handles enterprise IdP redirects and SCIM-provisioned tenants.

capabilities.name: Session Persistence & Reuse
capabilities.description: Authenticate once and reuse the session across runs.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Persists cookies within a single run.
Stores and restores a session across runs.
Detects expired sessions and silently re-authenticates.

capabilities.name: Bot / WAF Handling
capabilities.description: Reach products fronted by bot-detection or WAF services.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Passes trivial user-agent checks.
Reaches products behind common managed bot/WAF rules.
Sustains long sessions behind aggressive fingerprinting.

capabilities.name: SPA State Detection
capabilities.description: Recognise meaningful state changes that do not change the URL.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Detects route changes that update the URL.
Detects client-side view changes with no URL change.
Distinguishes meaningful state from cosmetic re-renders.

capabilities.name: Live DOM Mutation Tracking
capabilities.description: Track asynchronous DOM changes after an action.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Notices content that appears synchronously after a click.
Waits for async/XHR-driven content and settles before acting.
Tracks streaming/continuous mutation without thrashing.

capabilities.name: Iframe Traversal
capabilities.description: Interact with content rendered inside iframes.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Reads content from a same-origin iframe.
Drives input inside a cross-origin provider iframe (e.g. Stripe).
Coordinates flows that span the host page and multiple iframes.

capabilities.name: Multi-tab / Popup Handling
capabilities.description: Follow flows that open a new tab or popup window.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Detects that a popup opened.
Switches into a popup, acts, and returns to the opener.
Coordinates state across opener and multiple child windows.

capabilities.name: Text & Realistic Data Input
capabilities.description: Enter text and realistic data into form fields.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Types literal strings into plain inputs.
Enters context-appropriate values (emails, names, phone numbers).
Generates data that passes strict server-side / format validation.

capabilities.name: Validation-Aware Filling
capabilities.description: React to inline validation errors while filling a form.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Submits a form and notices a validation error occurred.
Reads inline errors and corrects the offending field.
Resolves interdependent / cross-field validation rules.

capabilities.name: Multi-Step / Conditional Form Flows
capabilities.description: Drive a form that spans multiple steps or pages to completion.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Completes a 2-step form on a happy path.
Handles back/next, conditional steps, and re-entry.
Recovers from validation errors and dynamic step insertion.

archetypes.name: Marketing Website
archetypes.description: Public, mostly server-rendered site with light forms and no auth wall.

archetypes.name: SaaS Application
archetypes.description: Authenticated single-page web app with forms and wizards behind a login.

archetypes.name: E-commerce
archetypes.description: Public storefront with search, multi-step checkout, and embedded payment.
